constants.name: schema_advisory_lock_key
constants.doc: The Postgres advisory lock every implementation holds while it creates, migrates or checks the schema (0x52554E4E45525121, "RUNNERQ!").

constants.name: work_channel_prefix
constants.doc: The prefix of a queue's LISTEN/NOTIFY channel announcing committed runnable work. The queue name follows.

constants.name: result_channel_prefix
constants.doc: The prefix of a queue's LISTEN/NOTIFY channel announcing committed results; the payload is comma-joined activity IDs. The queue name follows.

constants.name: business_key_prefix
constants.doc: The prefix of an encoded application idempotency key (vectors/business_key.json).

constants.name: step_key_prefix
constants.doc: The prefix of the idempotency key derived for an activity spawned by a step (vectors/step_key.json). Not an application key.

constants.name: serialization_json
constants.doc: The plain JSON serialization. An empty serialization means the same.

constants.name: serialization_superjson
constants.doc: The TypeScript SDK's serialization: a SuperJSON {json, meta} envelope.

enums.name: storage_error_kind
enums.doc: The kinds of storage error. The numbers are stored (runnerq_commands err_kind) and sent on the wire, so they never change.
